meta.title: Collaborate with Product Beers
meta.description: Help the product community as a sponsor or by lending your space.

hero.label: Collaborate
hero.description: We're a bunch of friends who get together to talk about product. If you want to help out, here's how.

sponsor.title: Buy the beers
sponsor.description: Keeping meetups free is cool. If your company can buy a round, everyone's happy.

visibility.title: Your logo around
visibility.description: On the website, social media and at the event.

community.title: Meet people
community.description: PMs, designers, devs. People who work in product.

networking.title: Come to the event
networking.description: You can introduce your company if you want, or just hang out.

content.title: Give a talk
content.description: If you want to share something, there's room.

hoster.title: Lend your space
hoster.description: Got a bar, terrace or office with space? We like to move around.

talent.title: New faces
talent.description: Product people who probably didn't know your place.

brand.title: They know you
brand.description: The community knows where you are.

social.title: We mention you
social.description: In the event posts and stories.

community.title: You stay
community.description: You and your team can join in.
